title: 第19章 十个里头八个是这恶心德性第20章 这崽子的胆比他爹都大
slug: 玄幻穿成野狗生崽就能变强
lines: 林野的爪子在乾坤袋上叩了一下。
互相牵制，说明短期内不会有大批修士联合攻山。
“打着除妖积功德的旗号，干的全是杀良冒功，逼人交孩子的勾当。”
“人族修士，十个里头八个是这恶心德性？”
巫风沉了一息。
“不全是，但干净的确实不多。”
“这片山域叫黑龙山脉，绵延数千里，越往深处灵气越浓，妖族越强，人族修者常来。”
“据说山脉腹地，有许多千年以上的老妖盘踞，更深处传闻有万年级的存在。”
林野心里惆怅。
所以自己一千年出头，搁这条山脉里，连中游都算不上。
他的路还长。
巫风继续抖情报。
“净言这帮人在天誉城外有个私下的据点，位置我清楚。”
林野的体型开始缩小，几个呼吸后变成三尺长，跳上了巫风的背。
“带路，我去看看。”
巫风在云层底部飞了大半个时辰。
下方的地形从荒野变低矮山谷。
山谷两侧的崖壁合拢，只留一个狭窄的入口。
巫风收翅俯冲，落在谷口外二十步的一块巨石上。
林野从鹰背跳下，妖气铺展开来。
巫风朝谷口方向偏了偏脑袋。
“就在里头，净言那帮人在谷口和谷内都布了阵。”
“什么阵不清楚我被他们拴了三年，进出都靠净言拿令牌开路。”
林野的妖力往谷口探，碰到了一层透明的灵力薄膜。
薄膜内侧嵌着细密的阵纹，是遮蔽，预警双重功能叠加的复合阵法。
这帮秃驴私底下的据点，防护做得不差啊。
林野没那个耐心试着破解，一爪拍在谷口的岩壁上。
灵力薄膜炸裂，谷内立刻炸了锅。
三道灵力波动从谷地深处窜出来，一前两后，呈品字形包抄。
当先一人手持铜禅杖，劈头就砸。
后面两个一左一右绕出来。
三人配合娴熟，出手没有丝毫犹豫。
禅杖砸到距林野头顶三尺的位置时，他偏了偏脑袋。
杖风擦着鬃毛尖过去，在地上砸出半尺深的坑。
content_en:
Lin Ye tapped his paw on the Qiankun bag.
The mutual restraint shows that there will not be a large number of monks jointly attacking the mountain in the short term.
"Under the guise of eliminating demons and accumulating merit, all they do is kill good people and take merit, and force people to hand over their children."
"Eight out of ten human monks have such disgusting virtues?"
Wu Feng took a deep breath.
"Not entirely, but certainly not many that are clean."
"This mountain range is called the Black Dragon Mountain Range, which stretches for thousands of miles. The deeper you go, the stronger the spiritual energy becomes, the stronger the monsters are, and the human cultivators often come here."
"It is said that there are many old monsters that are over a thousand years old in the hinterland of the mountains, and there are rumors of existences that are ten thousand years old in the deeper areas."
Lin Ye felt melancholy.
Therefore, I am only a thousand years old, and I am not even in the middle reaches of this mountain range.
He still has a long way to go.
Wu Feng continued to give information.
"Jingyan and his gang have a private stronghold outside Tianyu City. I know the location."
Lin Ye began to shrink in size, becoming three feet long after a few breaths, and jumped onto Wu Feng's back.
"Lead the way, I'll go take a look."
Wu Feng flew at the bottom of the clouds for most of an hour.
The terrain below changes from wilderness to low valleys.
The cliffs on both sides of the valley closed together, leaving only a narrow entrance.
Wu Feng folded its wings and swooped down, landing on a huge rock twenty steps outside the valley mouth.
Lin Ye jumped off the eagle's back, and the demonic aura spread out.
Wu Feng tilted his head towards the mouth of the valley.
"Inside, Jingyan and his gang have set up formations at the entrance and inside the valley."
"I don't know what the formation is. I have been tied up by them for three years. I rely on Jingyan to use tokens to clear the way in and out."
Lin Ye's demonic power probed towards the entrance of the valley and encountered a transparent film of spiritual power.
The inner side of the film is embedded with fine array patterns, which is a composite array with dual functions of shielding and early warning.
The private stronghold of these bald donkeys is well protected.
Lin Ye didn't have the patience to try to crack it, so he slapped his claws on the rock wall at the entrance of the valley.
The spiritual film burst, and the valley immediately exploded.
Three waves of spiritual power sprang out from the depths of the valley, one in front and two in back, forming a "pin" shape to surround him.
At first, a man held a copper Zen staff and smashed it on his head.
The next two go around one to the left and the other to the right.
The three of them cooperated skillfully and took action without any hesitation.
When the Zen staff hit Lin Ye three feet away from his head, he tilted his head.
The wind from the stick brushed the tip of the mane and made a half-foot-deep hole in the ground.
